aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was created by Dominic Bonini, who developed Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It is a small company, run by him himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something made for a business that is in a different place every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I created HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it. If you get in touch, you will hear from me, not from a customer support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come here, but I never knew which one was coming, or when, without digging through Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I created Village Foodie, a simple way to see which food trucks will pass through the villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Analyse sales by period, item and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a pager number to an order when you hand it to the customer, so you know which pager belongs to each order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers, with order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at a time and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty cards — stamps are given and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group items into meal deals and suggest extras at checkout to raise the average value of each order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your team their own logins, with the right level of permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders are paused, so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment at the moment of the online order, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and your ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only have to review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it becomes unavailable to customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the quantity in stock: it goes down as orders come in and the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible mobile phone, without needing a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot for the collection time, which spreads demand across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any mobile phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and your schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Say how much you can cook at a time and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the mobile phone you carry in your apron, the tablet at the counter, the laptop inside the food truck — and the card terminal you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same hours every week. But your food truck is somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or non-existent mobile coverage. HatchGrab was made for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders are paused automatically, so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp replies while you drive to the pitch or are at the grill, based on your menu and your schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will reply while you drive to the pitch or are at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
